authority: read-only source, canonical snapshot, tests, and current-host receipt inspection

findings.summary: Card admission accepts empty source-symbol arrays and non-ISO discovery timestamps.
Completion evidence is an arbitrary string array rather than structured, hash-bound evidence.
The operator CLI does not expose predecessor-safe control disposition revision or transition-admission backfill supported by the runtime.
Host-owned and not-applicable boundaries lack terminal proof rules; partial stages can reach operational verification.
Task switches do not prove exhaustive reconciliation of newly discovered branches or bind outgoing and incoming checkpoints.
Report registration trusts caller-supplied finding IDs and does not validate them against machine-readable report content.
Reopen transitions do not bind the contradicted prior verification/closure event, and duplicate replacement cards can conceal failed closure.
Progress reports evidence-lacking and unbound-evidence cards separately, allowing a zero required-evidence count while unbound evidence remains.
Control operational dispositions lacked exact current-host 13-stage proof and surface examination conflated disposition with behavior.
Direct PX-controlled host effects can occur without a predecessor-bound work admission.

claim_boundary: This manifest is gap discovery and reconciliation evidence only; it is not implementation, integration, operational verification, certification, or closure.
